Question 3 What is the Hanafi's viewpoint on dilivering the Friday's Khutba on the mimbar i.e in Arabic or any other language. Answer ID: 5146 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 851=H/1429) (1) Expert Ulama and scholars authorized of issuing Fatwa have gone to both the sides. Some of them opine that it is lawful and they say that shrimp is a kind of fish. Contrary to this, some have found out that it is neither a fish nor any of its kinds, so it is unlawful to eat it. According to us, one should avoid eating it, but if anyone eats then it is allowable for him. (2) The best and referred Fatwa is that both the khutbas (sermons) should be delivered in Arabic language. It has been explained explicitly with proofs in Fatwa Mahmoodia Vol.2 and Fatwa Rahimiah Vol.1. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
